fields.old: SDS: no claims. JSON performance_claims Missing.
fields.new_text: Slide 4 'Cascade Summary' (image checked): OLOA 59766 alone - 11.2 wt%: CI-4 / E7-16; SL, A3/B4-16; VDS3, Cat ECF-1a; 15W-40 20W-50 10W-40 10W-30 (finished BN 10.1); 9.33 wt%: CG-4 (CI-4 in GpII), E7-08; SJ, A3-B3/16; MB 228.3, MAN 3275, MB 229.1; 15W-40 20W-50, 10W-40 (PCMO) (BN 8.4); 8.2 wt%: CF-4, E2; MB 228.1, MAN 271; 15W-40 (BN 7.4); 7.0 wt%: CF-4 multigrade (BN 6.3). With boost: 12.9 wt% CI-4 / E7-16, SL A3/B4-16, Cat ECF-2 (BN 10.4); 15.4 wt% CI-4 / E4-16 / E7-16, MB 228.5, MAN 3277, 10W-40 (BN 12). Slide 13: claims at 11.2 wt% SAE 15W-40 (Gp I & Gp II) incl. GLOBAL DHD-1, MTU Type 2, MAN M3275-1, Renault RLD-2, Mack EO-N/EO-M Plus, Cummins CES 20078, DDC 93K215, Deutz DQC III-10, JASO DH-1 level, Allison C4 level; 'PCMO on going'. Slide 24: claims per formulation column, 'Levels' listed separately.
fields.reason: Propose adding the claims, each bound to its treat rate, grade and base-oil route as printed; booster routes kept separate from OLOA 59766 alone; items marked 'level', 'on going' or 'Performance Potential (may vary with base oils)' are recorded with that wording, not as approvals.

fields.reason: The existing 11.2 wt% equals the main CI-4 / E7-16 rate; propose binding it to that claim and grade route and adding the other rows each with its claim and grade. The 15.4 wt% booster is not named on slide 4; it is recorded as '59766 + Boost' without inferring the booster. Mass basis printed ('wt%').
